_help.what_is_this: Template campaign.json for CENTCOM campaigns. Copy this file, rename fields, and keep IDs consistent.
active_campaign_rule: Header finds FIRST operation .md where the 2nd NON-EMPTY line contains 'start' (case-insensitive).
That campaign becomes the active campaign.
id_rules: IDs must be unique within the campaign.
Commander IDs are referenced by orgChart.taskForceHQ.commanderId and orgChart.taskUnits[].commanderId.
Unit IDs are referenced by orgChart.taskUnits[].unitIds[] and roster.units[].id.
roster.units[].assignedTo should match a task unit id (orgChart.taskUnits[].id).
assets_rules: All images should live in /public and be referenced as '/path/to/file.png'.
portrait and patch can be blank; portraitFallbacks/patchFallbacks will be used instead.
operations_rules: operationsIndex is the primary operation list (CampaignLogView reads this).
Each operation should have a matching operations/<id>.md file if you want per-op metadata overrides or narrative text.
commandersRef and hallOfFameRef are the swappable keys used to link to Commanders & Hall of Fame pages.

_help_id: Unique campaign ID. Also good to use as folder name. Example: 'operation_atlas_2026_q1'.
name: Operation: Template Name
_help_name: Campaign display name shown across UI.
_help_status: active | completed | training | deployed | archived (lowercase recommended).
_help_location_fields: These drive the header 'SYSTEM / PLANET / AO' tiles and are searchable in CampaignLogView.
_help_theatre: Optional descriptor used in some views / future expansion.
_help_dates: Use ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Leave endDate blank for ongoing.
_help_quarter: Free text. Used for quick sorting/filter context.
_help_location: Human-friendly string shown in the campaign record.
overview: TEMPLATE: Replace this with a short, high-level summary of the campaign’s purpose and arc.
_help_overview: 1–3 sentences. Shown on the campaign card and in modal.

how_fallbacks_work: For a commander/unit, use portrait/patch if set.
